description: Header file defining the VdVideoDecodeAccelerator class, which implements a video decode accelerator interface backed by a VideoDecoder, specifically for ChromeOS. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and external dependencies related to video decoding and GPU buffer management.

classes.name: VdVideoDecodeAccelerator
classes.description: Implements a video decode accelerator for ChromeOS that uses a VideoDecoder backend, manages frame requests, and handles decoding operations with support for encrypted content and GPU buffers.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates an instance of VdVideoDecodeAccelerator and initializes it.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the decoder with configuration, client, and low delay setting.

methods.name: ImportBufferForPicture
methods.description: Imports a GPU memory buffer for a picture buffer.

methods.name: RequestFrames
methods.description: Requests frames from the frame pool with specified parameters.

methods.name: OnFrameReady
methods.description: Callback when a frame is ready.

methods.name: GetPicture
methods.description: Retrieves a Picture instance corresponding to a VideoFrame.

methods.name: OnFrameReleasedThunk
methods.description: Static method to post frame release callback to the task runner.

methods.name: OnError
methods.description: Handles errors and notifies the client.
